body.statement: Let a finite linear program have a nonempty feasible set and an objective bounded above. Then its Lagrange dual has the same finite value; the primal optimum is attained when its feasible set is compact, and the dual optimum is attained whenever the dual is feasible.

source.locator: Appendix A, finite-dimensional linear-program duality used for sharp bound programs
